shortDescription: Module for configuring LAG Interfaces in AOS-CX switches.

options.name: interfaces
options.description: List of interfaces in the LAG. Each interface added to a LAG interface will inherit the LAG manager state of the LAG, wether it is "up" or "down".

options.name: lacp_fallback
options.description: Enable LACP fallback mode, specified only for multi-chassis LAG.

options.name: lacp_mode
options.description: Configures Link Aggregation Control Procotol (LACP) mode on this interface, `active` ports are allowed to initiate LACP negotiations. `passive` ports can participate in LACP negotiations initiated by a remote switch, but not initiate such negotiations. If LACP is enabled on a port whose partner switch does not support LACP, the bond will be disabled. Defaults to disabled.

options.name: lacp_rate
options.description: Configures Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP) rate on this Interface, by default LACP rate is `slow` and LAPCDUs will be sent every 30 seconds; if LACP rate is `fast` LACPDUs will be sent every second. This value can not be set if lacp mode is disabled.

options.name: multi_chassis
options.description: Option to specify whether the LAG is an MCLAG. This option is mutually exclusive with the `lacp_mode` option. As an MCLAG forces the lacp_mode to `active`.

options.name: name
options.description: LAG Interface Name, the ID portion should be no lower than 1. Check your hardware specifications for its limitations. example: lag1, or lag256.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, Update or Delete the Interface. After that a physical interface is removed from a LAG, interface will be shutdown (admin state in down). LAG interface

options.name: static_multi_chassis
options.description: Whether the MCLAG is static. Ignored if `multi_chassis` is not specified.
